Com mais de R$ 8,5 bilhões investidos no setor, já apoiamos milhares de brasileiros a entrarem na universidade.
Somos a primeira edfintech do país e seguimos investindo na oferta de tecnologia e produtos para fortalecer o mercado. Afinal, é a educação que realiza!
Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Criar, documentar e testar todos os códigos e scripts escritos em SQL e Python, garantindo a qualidade e funcionalidade do trabalho desenvolvido;
  • Acompanhar e aplicar correções permanentes em problemas ocorridos nos pipelines de dados;
  • Contribuir com code reviews e colaborar com outras pessoas do time para garantir a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código;
  • Propor e implementar ações para atender todos os pilares de observabilidade dos dados que passam pela plataforma de dados;
  • Evoluir e garantir o bom funcionamento de toda a plataforma de dados e ser responsável por manter a organização dos dados dentro do Data Lake;
  • Definir e implementar padrões e checks de qualidade, garantindo o bom funcionamento e alta confiabilidade em todas as etapas do pipeline de dados;
  • Definir e implementar medidas de segurança como controle de acesso, criptografia e anonimização de dados;
  • Atuar em parceria com o time de Cybersegurança e garantir a aderência dos projetos à LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados);
  • Ser ponte entre áreas de negócio e analytics e a área de Engenharia de dados;
  • Treinar e evoluir o time de engenharia e analytics sobre a plataforma e melhores práticas de dados.
  • Ser uma referência técnica para a equipe, liderando e apoiando os desenvolvimentos da equipe de Engenharia de Plataforma de Dados;
  • Apoiar e desenvolver as implementações de soluções escaláveis e robustas utilizando Google Cloud Platform, incluindo Dataflow, Airflow e demais serviços relevantes;
  • Manter uma comunicação eficiente com a equipe e áreas envolvidas diretamente com os dados;
  • Contribuir para a estratégia de desenvolvimento e implementação, assegurando o uso de boas práticas, código limpo, testes automatizados e qualidade nas implantações;
  • Colaborar com áreas e stakeholders para atender necessidades e funcionalidades da plataforma de dados, garantindo a execução e priorização das atividades no time

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas;
  • Proficiência em SQL e Python;
  • Domínio em conceitos de ETL e pipeline de dados ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em ferramentas de orquestração e ingestão de dados como Datastream, Nifi, Airflow, entre outros;

Ser, até 2030, uma das cinco maiores instituições financeiras cooperativas de produtos e serviços no estado de São Paulo.

  • Conhecimento em matemática financeira;

description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos, guiados por nossos valores fortes, um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os nossos relacionamentos de negócio, incluindo ética, integridade, humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

Responsável por analisar toda a cadeia de suprimentos de defensivos, gerenciando riscos e prospectando oportunidades para que os resultados sejam iguais ou melhores que o previsto. Planeja ações para que as áreas de trading e supply chain tenham informações e orientações para a tomada de decisão correta. Desenvolve e homologa as contrapartes logísticas de acordo com a política da LDC, sob os pontos de vista comercial, de crédito, compliance e legal. Realiza follow-up com os fornecedores sobre os embarques dos produtos China x Brasil, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos. Analisa a posição considerando a estratégia dos produtos, custos operacionais e assegura o cumprimento do planejado versus o executado.

Principais responsabilidades

  1. Gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos de Defensivos: Gerenciar riscos e oportunidades em toda a cadeia de defensivos, do trading ao supply chain.
  2. Drawing Arcs: Construção de Drawing Arcs logísticos para alimentar o time comercial com oportunidades e aumentar a competitividade; análise do Drawing Arc e da carteira de vendas para definir estratégias de maximização de lucros e redução de custos.
  3. Long Short e MTM: Desenvolver KPIs da área e buscar otimizações nas análises; análise de MTM da carteira e estimativa de margem.
  4. Homologação de Fornecedores: Desenvolver e implementar plano de gestão de homologação de fornecedores logísticos nacionais e internacionais, garantindo conformidade com a política da LDC.
  5. Negociação de Fornecedores: Gestão e contratação de fretes rodoviários, marítimos e armazenagem nacionais e internacionais.
  6. Projetos: Liderar o desenvolvimento de novos negócios, incluindo expansão de portfólio, fusões e aquisições, alinhados às necessidades de médio e longo prazo.

Qualificações

  • Experiência no setor de agronegócio e commodities.
  • Experiência no ciclo de S&OP.
  • Experiência no mercado de defensivos agrícolas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e Power BI.
  • Conhecimento de planejamento e logística.

Informações adicionais

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Agronômica, Administração, Economia, Logística ou áreas afins.

Inglês avançado.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade faz parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro do nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados por criar valor justo e sustentável para nossos negócios e stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nossos colaboradores, parceiros comerciais, comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

description:
Operador de caixa

Qual será a sua missão?

Operar o caixa/PDV, registrando cuidadosamente e corretamente as compras, preservando os produtos, mantendo a qualidade e garantindo bom atendimento e satisfação dos clientes.

Quais são as principais responsabilidades

  1. Realizar atendimento ao cliente de forma empática e diferenciada;
  2. Organizar o caixa/PDV, proporcionando agilidade no atendimento, bem como realizar todas as atividades inerentes à função;
  3. Identificar diariamente os produtos disponíveis para venda e oferecer ao cliente adequadamente;
  4. Zelar pela segurança e bom uso dos equipamentos, manter o ambiente de trabalho e instrumentos limpos e organizados, cuidar da higiene pessoal e do uniforme, de acordo com a legislação e normas vigentes.

O perfil que buscamos em você!

  • Comunicação clara e empática com o cliente;
  • Relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Organização;
  • Orientação para o cliente;
  • Comprometimento com o resultado.

O que precisa ter?

Ensino médio completo.

Quais são os benefícios?

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Refeitório;
  • Cesta básica;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Convênio farmácia;
  • Programa de treinamentos;
  • Trilha de carreira;
  • Descontos em cursos e universidades parceiras.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

Adicionais benefícios: alimentação no local, plano de saúde, seguro de vida, convênio farmácia.

Sobre a empresa

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras, ajudando-os a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas em 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG). Nossas lojas atendem cerca de meio milhão de clientes por mês, com operações omnichannel, incluindo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces, entregando em até três horas em regiões atendidas. Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos mensalmente, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.

Nossa missão é promover uma vida mais natural, tornando-nos referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil. Nossos valores incluem jogo aberto, foco em resultados com qualidade, trabalho em equipe, excelência no atendimento, um jeito simples e alegre de ser, e atitude responsável.

Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, promovendo ambientes seguros, acolhedores, criativos e inclusivos. Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, bem como para todas as raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais.

title: EXECUTIVO COMERCIAL SR
description:
Job description

Fazer parte da Afinz é integrar uma empresa que é 100% a fim de pessoas, afinal, crescer juntos, lado a lado, é o que nos interessa. Por este motivo investimos no crescimento de todos, pois acreditamos que isso é fundamental para a continuação do nosso desenvolvimento como Cia, enquanto, paralelamente, você se torna cada vez mais protagonista da sua própria história.

Enxergamos os nossos profissionais além de colaboradores ou recursos, mas sim como Gente, que são partes fundamentais em nosso ecossistema, que é vivo e regido por nossa Cultura.

Pertencer a Afinz é ter espaço para vivenciar formas que unem ideias, pessoas e sonhos.

VemPraAfinz aqui a nossa afinidade vai de A a Z.


Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades:

  1. Mapear e prospectar clientes PJ, com foco nos ramos de atividades com propensão ao produto de Parcelamento Recorrente e/ou Assinaturas;
  2. Desenvolver e executar o planejamento comercial com foco em crescimento escalável e sustentável da carteira;
  3. Conduzir negociações comerciais, apresentando propostas alinhadas às necessidades do parceiro;
  4. Assegurar agenda robusta de vendas, tanto em prospecção (responsabilidade primária), como em gestão da carteira de clientes, a fim de garantir as entregas mínimas dos resultados estabelecido em orçamento, dentro dos padrões de qualidade e comercial definidos pela Companhia;
  5. Identificar oportunidades de negócio em novos segmentos e canais, incluindo parcerias B2B, para os produtos de Recorrência, Assinatura e Adquirência;
  6. Analisar tendências do setor financeiro e regulatório, ajustando estratégias de abordagem e proposta de valor;
  7. Colaborar com áreas internas (marketing, tecnologia, operações) para garantir uma jornada de cliente fluida e eficiente;
  8. Gerenciar metas, acompanhando KPIs e promovendo desenvolvimento contínuo e saudável da carteira de Clientes, propondo ações proativas quando pertinentes;
  9. Gerir carteira de Clientes PJ, promovendo evolução contínua do negócio e ampliando a capacidade de cross-sell de outras soluções;
  10. Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o modelo de negócio de cada Cliente para identificar oportunidades de otimização de produto e oferta;
  11. Mapear necessidades dos clientes e articular junto às áreas internas soluções adequadas a cada negócio (recorrência, assinatura, serviços de pagamento, onboarding, KYC, APIs bancárias, crédito, entre outros);
  12. Monitorar e conduzir o resultado das etapas do funil de vendas, acompanhando os principais KPIs (indicadores financeiros, volume de negócio, lead time, TMA, etc.) de forma a identificar oportunidades e possíveis cenários de crescimento;
  13. Atuar em conjunto com demais executivos da área comercial na avaliação de oportunidades em clientes e na geração de negócios e cross sell.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos:

  1. Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Conhecimento do Mercado de Meios de Pagamento e dos produtos de Recorrência e Assinatura;
  3. Experiência comprovada em posição de liderança comercial e vendas consultivas preferencialmente em empresas de Meios de Pagamento com foco em Recorrência e Assinatura;
  4. Histórico de sucesso comprovado conduzindo projetos comerciais;
  5. Conhecimento sólido do ecossistema financeiro, incluindo meios de pagamento, crédito ou banking;
  6. Domínio de métricas comerciais e ferramentas de CRM;
  7. Conhecimento das ferramentas de apoio como Excel, Power Point, Salesforce;
  8. Habilidade em negociação, comunicação e gestão de times;
  9. Visão estratégica e capacidade de execução;
  10. Capacidade de construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo;
  11. Atuação comercial proativa;
  12. Possuir carro próprio;
  13. Conhecimento e relacionamento com executivos em redes/grupos do ramo de Educação é desejável.

Additional information

Benefícios

Oferecer a melhor experiência de trabalho é um dos nossos maiores objetivos, confira os benefícios que você terá aqui na Afinz:

  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação

title: TECNICO DE MANUTENÇÃO PREDITIVA
description:
Job description

Executar plano de manutenção preditiva em equipamentos da indústria e auxiliar na execução dos serviços de manutenção em máquinas operatrizes, motores, dispositivos e equipamentos industriais, reparando e substituindo peças, fazendo ajustes, regulagem e lubrificação convenientes, utilizando máquinas, ferramentas e instrumentos de medição e controle, para assegurar-lhes o funcionamento regular e eficiente.


Main responsibilities

  1. Realizar inspeções de rotina para diagnosticar o estado de conservação e funcionamento dos equipamentos mecânicos;
  2. Executar planos de manutenção preditiva conforme criticidade dos equipamentos estabelecido;
  3. Realizar análises de vibração, temperatura e sensitiva nos equipamentos da indústria;
  4. Elaborar relatório de diagnóstico e prognóstico dos equipamentos que estão com vibração acima do recomendado pela norma ISO-10816-3 – 1998;
  5. Realizar melhoria continua no banco de dados dos equipamentos, e sempre cadastrar os novos equipamentos e garantir qualidade nas informações;
  6. Executar as rotas de análises conforme periodicidade definida pela criticidade dos equipamentos;
  7. Executar os trabalhos seguindo as ordens de serviço, checklist e outras atividades geradas pelo planejamento;
  8. Auxiliar na regulagem e calibragem de todos os equipamentos mecânicos e pneumáticos, conforme especificações de cada máquina, utilizando-se de instrumentos e ferramentas apropriadas;
  9. Auxiliar na manutenção, reparos e consertos mecânicos em: bombas em geral, redutores de velocidade, esteiras transportadoras, montagens de rolamentos e redutores, gaxetas, alinhamento e nivelamento de máquinas, elevadores de caneca, moinhos e outros, garantindo a melhor técnica aplicada nos ajustes mecânicos;
  10. Solicitar requisição de peças para reparos conforme relatórios de prognósticos e diagnósticos;
  11. Auxiliar na verificação e ajuste do alinhamento, centralização e nivelamento de todos os equipamentos e acessórios, identificando e informando sobre as falhas operacionais na produção;
  12. Verificar o estado de rolamentos, trocando-os se necessário, de acordo com padrões estabelecidos;
  13. Realizar lubrificação em todas as máquinas e equipamentos do setor industrial, seguindo um plano estabelecido para fazer as lubrificações, de acordo com o planejamento do setor quando necessário;
  14. Cuidar da ordem e limpeza da área e material de trabalho;
  15. Anotar os reparos feitos, peças trocadas, para efeito de controle;
  16. Zelar pelas ferramentas, equipamentos de precisão e materiais utilizados;
  17. Efetuar apontamentos necessários conforme plano de manutenção preventiva/preditiva;
  18. Fazer checklist de rota de manutenção;
  19. Realizar relatório mensal da saúde dos ativos monitorados;
  20. Executar as atividades da função respeitando todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente do trabalho, estabelecidos pela organização, bem como, utilizar constantemente todos os EPIs de uso obrigatório no desenvolvimento das atividades do cargo e do setor. Tendo a responsabilidade de informar ao seu superior imediato qualquer atividade que apresente risco a sua saúde ou dos demais colegas de trabalho;
  21. Exercer as atividades em comum acordo com os valores, políticas, diretrizes, procedimentos e processos da empresa, sempre focando nas metas organizacionais, e mantendo sigilo e protegendo as informações da companhia;
  22. Manter a disciplina no programa 5S, objetivando um trabalho seguro por meio da manutenção da organização, padronização e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho;
  23. Zelar pelas propriedades da empresa sob sua responsabilidade, informando ao superior imediato qualquer problema ou avaria detectada;
  24. Apoio as equipes da manutenção e do processo industrial, nas atividades necessárias para garantir a disponibilidade dos equipamentos industriais.

Requirements and skills

  1. Curso Técnico em mecânica e/ou áreas afins;
  2. Curso em análise de vibração.

title: Encarregado(a) de Safety
description:
Pronto pra decolar com a gente?

Queremos profissionais que não têm medo de pensar fora da caixa, amam trabalhar em equipe e entendem que grandes resultados vêm do esforço coletivo e de relacionamentos sólidos. Apoiamos quem quer crescer junto com a gente, com responsabilidade, criatividade e paixão pelo que faz.

Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, vem construir o futuro com a gente.

Missão do cargo:

Responsável por realizar as atividades operacionais de segurança, apoiando a implementação do Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança Operacional (SGSO) no aeroporto de sua competência, com o objetivo de contribuir para o atendimento às legislações e normas, bem como cumprimento de todos os requisitos para manutenção das certificações de segurança.

Atividades:

  • Apoiar o superior na certificação nos processos de segurança adequados em caso de alterações na infraestrutura, procedimentos, sistemas / instalações, principalmente no aeródromo local e em qualquer outro aeródromo em que seja necessário suporte de segurança;
  • Contribuir com o plano de auditoria de segurança e acompanhar as auditorias;
  • Compilar periodicamente as informações relacionadas às medições dos Indicadores de Segurança e monitorá-los, bem como as ações que surgem deles, além de distribuir as informações a quem elas correspondem;
  • Coletar os dados dos acidentes/ incidentes no lado aéreo do aeroporto e preparar os relatórios pertinentes;
  • Colaborar com os auditores nas auditorias e inspeções, bem como acompanhar as ações corretivas e / ou preventivas de sua competência, elaborando relatórios para o acompanhamento do superior imediato;
  • Detectar as necessidades de treinamento da equipe envolvida em Segurança Operacional, além de monitorar as ações de treinamento realizadas por controle ou pelas informações gerenciadas pelo RH ou Segurança.
  • Contribuir com o processo de certificação do aeroporto para ajudar que os padrões e recomendações operacionais e de design sejam cumpridos e que o Manual do Aeroporto seja atualizado.
  • Realizar o acompanhamento dos requisitos de segurança aplicáveis a terceiros;
  • Apoiar o superior no contato com o órgão regulador para aprovação de documentações de segurança do aeroporto.
  • Apoiar a padronização e formalização de políticas, normas e procedimentos internos, através do levantamento das práticas existentes nas unidades relacionadas à segurança, bem como os demais documentos históricos e levantamento da legislação vigente;
  • Realizar a garantia de segurança, conforme previsto no SGSO, enviando relatórios de segurança aos destinatários apropriados (ou seja, proprietários do processo, gerente responsável, conselho de revisão de segurança);
  • Promover a cultura de segurança, assessorando e apoiando as diferentes unidades;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia Aeronáutica, ou equivalente.
  • CNH B
  • Pacote Office Avançado
  • Conhecimento em Legislação ANAC
  • Conhecimento em Gereciamento SGSO
  • Conhecimento de Operações Aeroportuária

Somos um ecossistema movido pela força coletiva de talentos únicos. Por isso, valorizamos o papel de cada colaborador em nossa jornada de evolução, nutrindo a diversidade de ideias e opiniões e incentivando o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional de cada um.

Construímos o futuro, hoje

Cumprimos o que combinamos

Fazer o que é certo é mais do que a nossa obrigação, é nosso compromisso: Construímos relações de confiança porque só prometemos o que podemos entregar e sempre cumprimos o que combinamos.

Praticamos a colaboração

A cooperação é a nossa essência. Nascemos como cooperativa e a força do nosso negócio está nos vínculos que construímos e sustentamos.

Nosso ecossistema é feito pela soma de diferentes especializações e pela intenção genuína de valorizar a contribuição de cada um. Gostamos de trabalhar juntos, de pedir e oferecer ajuda, de contribuir com o todo.

Sabemos que são os resultados que viabilizam o crescimento dos nossos negócios, as soluções em escala, o desenvolvimento das pessoas e o fortalecimento dos agentes do ecossistema.

Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de oportunidades de fazer melhor o nosso trabalho, otimizando processos e buscando eficiência de tempo, recursos e energia em toda a nossa cadeia de valor.

title: Concurso Público para Engenheiro e Arquiteto em Paulínia
description:
A prefeitura de Paulínia abre concurso público para o preenchimento de vagas e formação de cadastro reserva para cargos de engenheiro civil , engenheiro agrônomo , engenheiro elétrico e arquiteto .

Para estas vagas a remuneração vai de R$ 3.867,50 a R$ 5.000,00 com direito a diversos benefícios e jornada de trabalho semanal de 40 horas.

As inscrições para o concurso público da Prefeitura Municipal de Paulínia iniciam-se em 30 de março de 2016 e terminam em 25 de abril de 2016 conforme descrito no edital .

O concurso é destinado ao provimento de 63 vagas e a formação de cadastro reserva (CR), para cargos em que é requerida formação de nível médio e de nível superior.

São diversos os cargos mas destacamos aqui os de engenheiro agrônomo (CR), engenheiro civil (03 vagas), engenheiro elétrico (CR) e arquiteto (CR).

Para engenheiro civil, agrônomo ou elétrico a remuneração prevista é de R$ 5.000,00. Já para arquiteto a remuneração prevista é de R$ 3.867,50. Para ambos os cargos são oferecidos, conforme previsto em lei, 14° salário (Leis nº 1.965/96, 2.431/02 e 2.504/02), auxílio alimentação de R$ 100,00 (Lei nº 2.490/01), auxílio transporte de R$ 28,00 (Lei nº 1.081/87 e Decreto 4.246/97) além de auxílio saúde de R$ 35,00 (Lei nº 2.493/01) e a carga horária semanal de trabalho é de 40 horas.

Além dos já citados, existem também os seguintes cargos para profissionais de nível superior: Professor (diversas especialidades), Médico Plantonista (clínico e pediatra), Cirurgião Dentista Plantonista, Veterinário, Contador, Analista de Sistemas, Diretor de Unidade Escolar e Procurador.

Para nível médio, os cargos são: Ag. de Desenvolvimento Infantil, Ag. de Administração Pública, Ag.de Fiscalização, Monitor Escolar, Orientador Social e Ag. de Controle de Vetor.

Inscrição no concurso

Os interessados em inscreverem-se no concurso público para os cargos mencionados deverão acessar a página de inscrição no site da FGV Projetos clicando aqui .

Mais informações sobre o concurso público para a Prefeitura Municipal de Paulínia podem ser obtidas pelo telefone 0800 2834628 e pelo e-mail concursoprefeituradepaulinia2016 @ fgv.br a partir de 24/03/2016.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Planejamento e Controle Financeiro:

  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros e realizar análises de variações orçamentárias.
  • Implementar e manter controles internos robustos para mitigar riscos financeiros e garantir conformidade.
  • Contribuir na elaboração e acompanhamento do orçamento anual e forecasts financeiros.
  • Preparar e revisar demonstrações financeiras (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial e Fluxo de Caixa).

Gestão de Parceiros Externos:

  • Coordenar e acompanhar o escritório de contabilidade terceirizado para garantir a qualidade e pontualidade na entrega de relatórios contábeis e fiscais.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato com auditores externos, garantindo a pronta entrega de documentos e respostas às demandas da auditoria.

Compliance e Governança:

  • Garantir a conformidade com regulamentações fiscais, contábeis e trabalhistas.
  • Monitorar mudanças nas legislações contábeis e tributárias, implementando ações para garantir a conformidade da empresa.

Inglês - Nível Fluente

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Sales Operations Analysts to join a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be a leader who shows initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions.
The role entails

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Review opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Manager to improve sales data quality and processes
  • Report on data quality metrics to executive level stakeholders
  • Implement surveys and define metrics for executive level stakeholders
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Lead automation and streamline the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience in a sales operations/sales order processing role
  • Experience in a technology subscription-based business
  • Experience driving data quality improvement
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to manage across boundaries and communicate effectively, particularly working with Sales, Legal, Finance and Marketing teams
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Job Title: Account Manager / Strategic Growth Partner

Position Overview: The Strategic Growth Partner is responsible for overseeing the complete sales and recruitment lifecycle with the client, ensuring efficient client management from lead to onboarding. This role focuses on taking initial discovery calls, understanding client job description needs, delivering service, maintaining organized workflows, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve client satisfaction and operational excellence.

About Us: Virtustant is a rapidly growing global staffing solutions provider dedicated to matching exceptional professionals with companies across various industries. Our mission is to connect businesses with the right talent to drive success and innovation. With a focus on quality, reliability, and efficiency, we strive to exceed the expectations of both our clients and candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Client-Focused Responsibilities:

  1. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients during the sales and recruitment process, ensuring clear communication and timely updates.
  2. Being knowledgeable on pricing, job descriptions, and long-term planning to build strong relationships with the client.
  3. Conduct structured follow-ups at key milestones (e.g., after Discovery Calls, during recruitment phases) to ensure client satisfaction and alignment.
  4. Gather and analyze client feedback regarding the recruitment process and provide actionable insights.
  5. Manage client expectations and address concerns promptly during the recruitment phase.

Candidate-Focused Responsibilities:

  1. Develop a comprehensive initial job description that provides clear guidelines and expectations for the recruitment team. This description should outline the key responsibilities, qualifications, and skills required for the role, ensuring that it serves as a reliable foundation for the recruitment efforts.
  2. Help vetting and shortlisting candidates for client review.
  3. Organize and facilitate candidate interviews, ensuring client readiness through detailed instructions and guidelines.

Operational Responsibilities:

  1. Collaborate with Recruitment and HR teams to ensure timely and efficient delivery of services, including handoffs for new roles or clients.
  2. Maintain comprehensive records of client interactions, feedback, and performance metrics for continuous improvement.
  3. Be a part of Ruling Meetings with recruiters to evaluate candidate viability and finalize shortlists.
  4. Oversee and streamline the contract and payment processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  5. Facilitate the transition of clients to HR Consultants for ongoing role management once hiring is complete.
  6. Propose and implement process improvements, including automation and documentation updates.

Recurring Tasks:

Client-Facing Tasks

  1. Schedule and conduct follow-ups post-Discovery Call.
  2. Facilitate hiring processes, including sending General Contract and Payment documentation, providing onboarding recommendations, and ensuring smooth transitions.
  3. Handle new hiring processes, ensuring a smooth process as needed.

Internal Operational Tasks:

  1. Collaborate on the creation and refinement of processes, automation, and internal documentation.
  2. Support cross-departmental initiatives by sharing information, managing exceptional cases, and contributing to training materials.
  3. Develop and maintain organizational policies and internal guides.
  4. Conduct regular check-ins with recruiters to address day-to-day topics and ensure alignment.

Qualifications and Skills:

  1. Proven experience in sales, or client relationship management.
  2. Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities.
  3. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  4. Proficiency in CRM systems, scheduling tools, and communication platforms.
  5. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  6. Analytical mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and results.

Language Requirement:

  1. C2 Level of English Proficiency.

Reporting and Collaboration:

  1. Reports to the Sales Manager.
  2. Collaborates closely with recruiters, HR Consultants, and marketing teams.
  3. Serves as a liaison between clients and internal teams to ensure seamless communication and process execution.
  4. Conduct annual reviews to reflect on performance metrics and plan for future needs.

Performance Metrics:

  1. Number of leads successfully converted to clients.
  2. Timeliness and accuracy in the recruitment process and offboarding activities.
  3. Client satisfaction during the process and after onboarding.
  4. Successful placement rates and feedback from clients.

Salary and Benefits:

  1. Weekly Payment in USD or Local Currency according to your preference.
  2. Commission structure available on top of base salary.
  3. 100% remote position
  4. 10 days of paid time off annually
  5. 6 paid holidays (3 fixed and 3 flexible)

Job Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented YouTube Production Manager to join our fast-growing marketing agency that helps top-ranked real estate teams ($10M to $1B/YR+ in annual volume) build their personal media brands. Your role is to oversee our video production ecosystem, ensuring flawless execution of 45-80 high-quality videos monthly (with a team of 3-5 people) while maintaining exceptional client satisfaction and channel growth.
Are you obsessed with YouTube (or Social Media) success? Someone who lives and breathes video optimization? Do you have a talent for managing multiple brand voices and coordinating creative teams? Are you equally comfortable diving into analytics and providing strategic direction? If so, we might be the perfect match.
Core Responsibilities

  • Lead entire video production workflow from raw footage to final publishing
  • Coordinate resources across editing, thumbnail, and publishing teams
  • Manage channel optimization and publishing schedules for multiple real estate clients
  • Track and optimize team capacity and production efficiency
  • Implement and refine production SOPs and best practices
  • Monitor YouTube analytics and adjust strategies for maximum channel growth
  • Ensure consistent 48-72 hour turnaround times while maintaining quality standards
  • Drive client success metrics including subscriber growth and lead generation

Requirements
  • 2+ years experience in video production management, preferably in YouTube content
  • Strong understanding of YouTube best practices and optimization strategies
  • Experience managing creative teams and coordinating multiple projects
  • Proficiency with project management tools (Asana preferred)
  • Excellence in organization and timeline management
  • Strong analytical skills for performance tracking and optimization
  • Outstanding communication abilities

Expected Results
  • 56+ videos consistently delivered monthly
  • 90%+ on-time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving 100-1000 subscriber growth monthly
  • Support of client revenue goals ($8M+ in sales per client)
  • Seamless team coordination and workflow optimization

Who We Are
A Impact Media is a specialized creative agency helping real estate professionals build their own media brands instead of buying leads. We transform top-producing agents and teams (doing $10M to $1B+/YR in annual volume) into local market authorities through done-for-you YouTube content, email marketing, and brand development.
Our dedicated team of 25+ creative professionals has generated over 7M+ YouTube views and helped our clients achieve more than $150M in sales. We're not just a service provider we're a growth partner obsessed with turning real estate professionals into media companies that naturally attract the right clients and team members.
With a track record of producing over 1,000 videos, 3,300+ thumbnails, and hundreds of newsletters for industry leaders, we combine creative excellence with proven systems to deliver consistent results. Our core values of proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence drive everything we do.

  • Send a link to your completed personality quiz:
  • Your answer to this question: What's the most innovative YouTube strategy you've implemented and what were the results?

title: UX Designer
description:
Join to apply for the UX Designer role at VML .

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, offering deep insights in communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

Who We Are Looking For

The UX Designer will work directly with external clients, understanding their needs and providing user-centered design solutions that enhance digital experiences. The candidate must be proficient in Figma, Sketch, or similar design tools and should have experience in user research, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing. They must be able to maintain fluent conversations in English and possess a Bachelor's degree in fields related to UX/UI Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a similar discipline.

What You'll Do

  1. UX Design:
    • User research: interviews, surveys, usability testing
    • Creation and tracking of wireframes, prototypes, and experience maps
    • Analysis of user flows and experience optimization
    • Definition of interaction strategies and intuitive navigation
  2. UI Design:
    • Visual design of attractive interfaces, focusing on aesthetics and functionality
    • Creation of scalable and consistent design systems
    • Knowledge of component creation and usage
    • Use of design tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, etc.
    • Development of interactive and high-fidelity prototypes
    • Knowledge in building brand guidelines (UI kits)

What You'll Need

  • Advanced English (must)
  • Proven experience in UX design
  • Academic background in UX/UI
  • Design tools: Figma (must), Sketch, Illustrator, Photoshop, Adobe XD, InVision, Zeplin, Miro
  • Communication skills: Presenting and defending design proposals to stakeholders

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

VML is a WPP Agency. For more information, please visit our website, and follow VML on our social channels via Instagram, LinkedIn, and X.

  • Estruturar, desenvolver e otimizar práticas e ferramentas de DevSecOps nos ambientes, contribuindo com a melhoria contínua por meio de frameworks de automação de testes, ferramentas de análise de código como o SonarQube, e outras ferramentas de varredura de cibersegurança.

  • Documentar decisões arquiteturais, processos, incluindo protocolos de instalação, especificações técnicas (BSDS) e documentação relevante para GxP, garantindo gestão do conhecimento e conformidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as mais recentes tecnologias e tendências em DevSecOps, com forte ênfase em OpenShift e Kubernetes locais, definindo a direção estratégica para sua adoção.
Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro ou Arquiteto DevSecOps, com significativa atuação em ambientes locais (on-premises).
  • Sólido entendimento dos princípios e práticas de DevOps, SecOps e GitOps, com foco estratégico em infraestruturas locais.

description:

Join to apply for the Associate Linux Support Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Associate Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. This role is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we've never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. This is a globally remote role.
Location: This is a globally remote role.
The role entails

  • Working from your remote home office to provide technical support for employees.
  • Being available to take ownership of new cases via telephone, email and web
  • Acting as an internal customer advocate keeping them updated in a timely manner
  • Ensuring that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Contributing new knowledge base articles and maintaining existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Drafting and distributing technical notices for internal and external communication.
  • Prioritising your work in order to accomplish the most important and urgent tasks first
  • Keeping on learning as our products and services grow and evolve
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix
  • Maintaining regular communication and information exchange with the rest of the team, locally and remotely
  • Identifying and suggesting any opportunities to provide a better service
  • Participating in a regular weekend working rotation
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Preferable majors: Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering, etc.
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)
  • Knowledge or basic hands-on experience on 2 or more of:
    • Linux server administration
    • Programming fundamentals in any language (bash, Perl, Ruby, Javascript, C or C++, Go)
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.)
    • Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)
  • Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Noting that we require and will perform a background check for this role.
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare)
  • Experience with other open-source desktop technologies
  • Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Join a team that delivers excellence.

Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN) is home to nearly 23,000 colleagues who make up our talented, vibrant and diverse workforce. Join our team and experience firsthand what it's like to be part of a health care organization that's nationally recognized, forward–thinking and offers plenty of opportunity to do great work.

Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward–thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital – Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital – Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital– Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital – Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary

Assists the radiologist in various radiology procedures by prepping patients beforehand through explaining the process to them, checking their vital signs, administering medicine, and providing care for patients undergoing imaging procedures. Provides nursing services, helps to carry out physician orders, responds and reports to attending/radiologist any changes in condition, oversees the distribution of medications, charts medications, distributes/counts narcotics, and responds to emergencies.


Job Duties
  • Assesses patients prior to their procedures by studying patient medical histories, reviewing patient history and Lab values, and speaking with both patients and their physicians.
  • Administers conscious sedation per hospital policy.
  • Helps patients better understand the procedures they need and serves as a liaison between the patient, nursing staff, and physician. Attends to the needs of the patient while in Radiology. Provides proper patient care, comfort, and understanding at all times.
  • Communicates with RN or patient's physician any change in status, medications given, and any intervention taken, including transportation of patient back to unit if indicated. Initiates post procedure orders and communicates all pertinent data to the nursing unit and accompanies patient to unit, if indicated.
  • Discharges patient from interventional per Aldrette score/Anesthesia guidelines.
  • Inputs all LDA lines in EPic. Documents that a implanted supply has been exported in patients chart in EPic.
  • Responds to all code blues and RRT within Radiology. Assists radiologists and code teams as needed.
  • Collaborates with Pediatric Intensivist for sedation of Pediatric cases. Follows PALS guidelines.
  • Performs pre and post procedure telephone calls for outpatients.
  • Follows National Patient Safety Goals including complete Invasive Procedure Checklist and patient identification. Completes patient safety reports, as indicated.
  • Serves as a clinical resource for the nursing staff, patients, and healthcare providers.
  • Maintains equipment and room cleanliness. Puts unused supplies away and restocks as needed. Assumes responsibility for cleanliness and sanitation of the immediate work area. Does light housekeeping. Maintains orderliness.
  • Provides radiation protection in accordance with prescribed safety standards. Assumes responsibility and accountability for his/her own safety and the safety of others.
  • Assists in the education and training of new employees, students, and other ancillary personnel.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate's Degree Nursing
  • 3 years Experience in medical/surgical nursing and
  • 1 year Critical care
  • Ability to obtain and interpret information in terms of the patients needs that are age appropriate.
  • Ability to select proper instrumentation/supplies appropriate for age group of patient served.
  • Ability to administer moderate sedation, dysrhythmia recognition, and treatment.
  • Able to work under stressful situations.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • ACLS – Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • PALS – Pediatric Advanced Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • RN – Licensed Registered Nurse—PA – State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire

Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree Nursing

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

description:
Brex: AI-powered Spend Platform

Brex is the AI-powered spend platform that helps companies manage their expenses with integrated corporate cards, banking, global payments, and intuitive software for travel and expenses. Thousands of companies, from startups to enterprises—including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass—use Brex to control spending, reduce costs, and increase efficiency globally.

Working at Brex means pushing your limits, challenging the status quo, and collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture, empowering you with the tools, resources, and support needed to grow your career.

Our mission is to reimagine financial systems to help growing companies realize their full potential. As the financial OS, we develop software and services that disrupt traditional institutions with innovative products and experiences tailored to our customers' ambitions.

Engineering at Brex

The Engineering team encompasses Data, IT, Security, and Software, responsible for creating innovative products and infrastructure for internal and external users. Our autonomous, collaborative teams are eager to learn, teach, and improve continuously. We aim to build robust, scalable systems that enable Brex's rapid growth and help our customers succeed. Engineers take pride in their work, ownership, and accountability, knowing that today’s software forms the foundation for future systems.

What You’ll Do

We seek passionate individuals to build data-driven risk management systems. You will gain exposure to all aspects of financial crime prevention, from developing customer-facing experiences to collaborating with data scientists to integrate models into production. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential, as the role involves interfacing with multiple systems across Brex.

You will work on high-impact projects, maintaining data integrity, ensuring compliance, and driving financial outcomes. This role offers specialized knowledge in risk management and contributes to building trusted financial services while safeguarding customers, the platform, and market integrity.

Where You’ll Work

This role is based in our São Paulo office. You must be willing to work in the office at least two days per week on Wednesdays and Thursdays, starting the week of September 1st, 2025, when our São Paulo office opens.

Responsibilities

  1. Ensure high-quality data for decision systems, using risk vendors and internal models to provide actionable insights for risk management and customer experience improvements.
  2. Develop low-latency decision systems for risk assessment during onboarding, payments, authentication, and in-app processes, leveraging machine learning models.
  3. Build in-product tools to enhance decision systems while making risk management unobtrusive.
  4. Create systems for comprehensive customer due diligence, including KYC, sanctions, adverse media, PEP, and AML monitoring.

Minimum Requirements

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Kotlin, Go, Python, or Java. Experience with Kotlin is a plus.
  • Foundational knowledge of Machine Learning and experience working with ML-integrated systems, supporting model deployment and feature pipelines.
  • Interest in data-driven systems, solving complex problems, and risk management (prior risk experience is not required).
  • Aptitude for building effective, user-centric tools for internal teams.
  • Strong ownership, motivation to protect customers, and high standards.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to work in the São Paulo office at least two days per week on Wednesdays and Thursdays.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or publications.
  • Experience with low-latency decisioning systems at scale and deploying models.

Note: Job-seekers should be cautious of malicious actors seeking personal data. Brex recruiters will only contact candidates via LinkedIn or email from the @brex.com domain. Beware of outreach from other sources claiming to be from Brex.

Req#: 00284939-304a-4252-b14a-b11c00ef2443

The Store Manager (SM) is responsible for managing all aspects of the business, with minimal direct supervision from the General Manager (GM), to ensure that Guests are delighted with a fast, friendly, fresh, clean, and in stock shopping experience, teaching and demonstrating core values, and supporting the GM in achieving store goals and initiatives. The SM assists the GM in maintaining a Staffed, Stable & Scheduled environment by providing a consistent Team Member experience through training, coaching, and recognition, while fostering a safety culture by Believing in Zero.

Essential Job Functions (Responsible to)

  1. Drive a safety culture by ensuring a clean, organized, and safe environment for all Team Members and Guests. Ensure proper procedure is followed relating to safety, accidents, and incidents including reporting, investigations, and documentation.
  2. Create a place of welcoming and belonging for our Guests and Team Members.
  3. Oversee the daily execution of the Store Operating System through management of the Game Plans to deliver a consistent Guest/brand experience that enables the store to achieve performance targets and improve financial performance; ability to delegate tasks accordingly and follow up to ensure completion.
  4. Engage and lead company initiatives.
  5. Oversee fresh food production to ensure food safety requirements are always met and par levels are maintained for a craveable and consistent offering, while growing sales and controlling waste.
  6. Develop well trained Team Members by following Thorntons’ training processes as prescribed while demonstrating and teaching our core values.
  7. Support and guide Team Members through career path while holding Team Members to a high standard of execution through coaching and accountability via Thorntons’ Progressive Discipline Process.
  8. Assist GM in facilitating the labor model by ensuring the team is working the schedule to our standard to maintain adequate coverage for all shifts.
  9. Train and empower Team Members to de-escalate Guest service issues.
  10. Communicate with Team Members in a positive manner that motivates and inspires them to act in accordance with Plan to Win strategy.
  11. Use a point-of-sale cash register and other electronic equipment.
  12. Comply with all federal, state, and local inspectors by taking immediate and appropriate action, and communicating and maintaining records of all inspections, certificates, and necessary records.
  13. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Key Relationships

  1. Region Manager
  2. General Manager
  3. Guest Service Representative
  4. Human Resource Manager
  5. Recruiter
  6. Trainer
  7. Auditor

Skills

  1. Demonstrates a commitment to leading by example, considering no tasks as below one’s position.
  2. Contributes to setting work priorities and direction, supporting the team in achieving goals and objectives.
  3. Demonstrates a positive and approachable presence, even during stressful situations.
  4. Recognizes positive performance, celebrates team achievements, and addresses poor performance.
  5. Provides feedback effectively and with empathy.
  6. Collaborates with GM to deliver high-quality Guest service.
  7. Fosters team camaraderie, collaboration, and cohesion.
  8. Proactively identifies potential issues and works with GM to take action to avoid workplace disruptions.
  9. Uses 'active listening' to understand viewpoints of others. Adjusts one's position/view to try and resolve conflict.
  10. Uses analytical skills to identify and solve a variety of business-related problems.

Physical Requirements

description:
Tech Lead (Android)

São Paulo-SP, Brazil or Porto Alegre-RS, Brazil

Who We Are

In 2021, Poatek was acquired by WillowTree, an award-winning digital product consultancy recognized as one of the fastest growing and best places to work in the United States. Now a TELUS International company , with offices across the globe, we continue to partner with the world’s leading brands, such as the NBA, Capital One, HBO, PepsiCo, Domino’s and more, to design, build, and transform their digital products and strategies. We’re looking to grow our Poatek offices in Brazil with top talent excited to collaborate with team members across the globe to deliver innovative solutions for our clients.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role, which we’ve termed Work from Near (WFN). This model requires the ability to work on-site from our São Paulo - SP or Porto - RS office throughout the week based on team needs, while still providing the flexibility to work remotely on other days. Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As a Tech Lead (Android), you will be at the forefront of our dynamic team, leading the design of applications, tools, and processes while ensuring value, clarity, and maintainability. Your role will involve expertly navigating and enhancing client tech stacks, executing large-scale refactors, and advocating for world-class engineering practices. You will be instrumental in driving teams to reduce change fail percentages, resolving conflicts, advocating for new practices, and tailoring your communication to diverse scenarios. Furthermore, you are expected to tackle psychological safety impediments and mentor team members, fostering a conducive work environment across the entire build cycle.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the team and client in designing applications, tools, and processes, optimizing for value, clarity, and maintainability.
  • Plan and drive execution of large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem, managing dependencies and minimizing risk.
  • Use your strong understanding of the Android development lifecycle and ecosystem to help the team navigate non-trivial testing scenarios, such as video streaming, Bluetooth, and other peripherals, poor network conditions, etc.
  • Champion the adoption and implementation of new practices for project teams and clients, while using IDE’s, version control like Git, and command line tools effectively.

Additional Responsibilities

On-Call Support: This role includes periodic on-call duties to support our critical systems. Aligned with our commitment to work-life balance, we maintain a strict 10-hour daily work limit, even during on-call periods. Team members may be required to respond to issues outside of regular business hours on a rotational basis. Compensation for on-call duty is provided in accordance with Brazilian labor laws.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience (10+ years) as an Android Engineer, with a track record of leading complex projects.
  • Expert knowledge in implementing world-class engineering practices.
  • Deep understanding of client tech stacks and the ability to integrate and improve them over a series of projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and execute large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of the Android development Lifecycle and ecosystem including languages, frameworks, and libraries (Java, Kotlin, Room, Coroutines/Flow, RxJava, Dagger 2, Gradle, Fragments, OkHttp3, Retrofit or Volley).
  • Comfort with IDE’s, version control systems such as Git, and command-line tools.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure, GitHub Actions) and experience setting up deployment pipelines.
  • Experience in frequently using frameworks such as Espresso, JUnit, Mockito/Mockk to write automated tests for your code.
  • Proven ability to recognize symptoms of various impediments to psychological safety and provide effective support.

Bonus Points

  • Expertise in choosing and executing deployment strategies that minimize risk and maximize client ROI.
  • Deep understanding and empathy for client hesitations around frequent releases, with proven strategies on how to overcome those hurdles.
  • Proven ability to balance helping and teaching with the need to finish things.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across a team to identify the level of support each team member needs in implementing different features.

Why Poatek?

What We Offer:

  • Be part of an innovative consultancy with a human-centered and culture with opportunities for ownership and professional growth
  • Competitive salary and benefits package (annual bonus)
  • Opportunity to work on innovative agile projects with other high-performing, passionate team members from all over the globe (international travel opportunities)
  • Collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development (including English classes, support in national and international courses,
  • Flexible work hours and autonomy
  • Voucher for health activities, food allowance, in-office snacks, drinks, and games

If you love IT as much as we do, we look forward to meeting you!

Equality is a principle here at Poatek. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
  • Facilitate release activities across all releases, mainly with ensuring quality, timely deployments across environments
  • Maintains the release schedule for all core services and ensure alignment across key partners and vendors.
  • Coordinate release content and effort based on the service request backlog, pending service requests, third party applications, or operating system updates
  • Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including QA plans, schedule, and scope changes.
  • Conduct Release Readiness reviews, Milestone Reviews, and Business Go/No-Go reviews with stakeholders
  • Produce Deployment, Run Books and Implementation Plans
  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)
  • Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists.
  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.
  • Understanding of Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus
  • Knowledge on MS Project, Excel-Macros
  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams towards task completion
  • Demonstrated effective leadership and analytical skills
  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
    Desired Technical Stack:
  • Platforms : Windows, Linux.
  • Database : MSSQL
  • Ticketing Tools: Service now
  • Cloud Environment : MS Azure
  • CI and Build Deployment Tools : Octopus Deploy
  • Version Control Tool : Azure Devops
  • Monitoring tools : Grafana

title: MICHELIN - Engenheiros recém-graduados para área de Desenvolvimento de Produto
description:
Job description

A melhor maneira de ir mais longe começa aqui.

Você sabia que a Michelin tem mais de 130 anos de história e está presente em mais de 170 países, sendo referência global em mobilidade segura, eficiente e sustentável? No Brasil, a Michelin atua há mais de 100 anos com tecnologia de ponta na fabricação de pneus, serviços e soluções inovadoras — sempre com foco na qualidade, segurança e respeito ao meio ambiente.

E como pessoas são o centro de tudo que fazemos, seguimos investindo na construção de um ambiente cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e inovador.

Pensando nisso, em parceria com o Instituto Primeira Geração (PriG) — organização que apoia pessoas que são a primeira geração de suas famílias a concluir o ensino superior — temos o orgulho de lançar o Programa Primeira Geração- Michelin 2025.

Voltado para pessoas recém-formadas no ensino superior, o programa oferece uma oportunidade única de desenvolvimento profissional, unindo a vivência prática de um estágio de pós-graduação na Michelin com um MBA prático, que será cursado ao longo do programa, relacionado à sua área de formação. Além disso, você contará com uma rede de apoio e aprendizado contínuo para impulsionar sua trajetória profissional.

Gostou? Então venha fazer parte da Michelin/PriG!

Quer conhecer mais sobre a Michelin? Seguem os canais:

Site : michelin.com.br/

Instagram : @michelinbrasil

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/michelin/


Main responsibilities

A área de P&D de Pneus para Ônibus e Caminhões é responsável por desenvolver soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis que atendam às necessidades dos clientes, com foco em segurança, performance e durabilidade. Nosso desafio é criar produtos que gerem valor para o cliente e para a empresa, contribuindo para sua competitividade e saúde econômica.

Com forte interface com as áreas de Marketing e Industrial, atuamos de forma colaborativa e global, em constante troca com times de desenvolvimento de outros continentes, buscando alinhamento e sinergia nas soluções técnicas.

E você desenvolverá as seguintes atividades:

  • Apoiar a equipe de desenvolvimento de produtos em todas as etapas dos projetos, contribuindo com atividades técnicas e operacionais;
  • Auxiliar na realização de simulações por elementos finitos (FEA), colaborando na análise estrutural e no estudo do comportamento dos pneus em diferentes condições de uso, com foco na otimização da performance e durabilidade;
  • Contribuir com a análise de produtos existentes no mercado, por meio de investigações técnicas sobre o desempenho e as características dos pneus já lançados;
  • Apoiar nas análises técnicas para identificação de causas relacionadas a problemas de desempenho, colaborando com sugestões de melhorias e ajustes no design;
  • Dar suporte na elaboração de relatórios e recomendações técnicas, com base nas análises realizadas, visando subsidiar a tomada de decisão com foco em performance, segurança e eficiência;
  • Colaborar com atividades transversais junto a outras áreas envolvidas no desenvolvimento de produtos, promovendo a integração e o alinhamento dos projetos;
  • Auxiliar na gestão de iniciativas relacionadas à excelência operacional, acompanhando o andamento das atividades e contribuindo para o cumprimento de prazos, processos e metas da equipe.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e qualificações obrigatórios :

  • Fazer parte da primeira geração da família a concluir o ensino superior;
  • Ter no máximo 4 anos de conclusão do ensino superior;
  • Graduação completa em Engenharia;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar 3 dias presenciais (Estrada da Cachamorra- Campo Grande / RJ) e 2 dias home-office.

Position Summary:

Bentley Systems is seeking a talented individual to become a valued member of the Product Support team as aTechnical Support Engineer.
