The position is responsible for problem analysis, documentation, resolution, and escalation involving Bentley’s supported products

We will rely on you for the following:

  • Provide troubleshooting and technical assistance for ProjectWise Product functionality/features to users via e-mail, service tickets, phone, and web-portal (BE Communities.
  • Assist with all facets of Bentley users and technical support by helping to identify user issues by isolating and resolving the issue or by proper escalation.
  • Advise and educate users on accurate usage of the Product and address specific use cases reported on the Service Requests.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between users and Product Management/Development.
  • Research and identify solutions to ProjectWise Product functionality/features.
  • Ask users targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Maintain accurate notes and details on user support requests.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g., software developers).
  • Communicate with team members regarding current/ongoing issues via daily scrum calls.
  • Document software problem defects for review and take corrective actions.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of Knowledgebase Articles or Communities Posts.
  • Meet with internal Bentley teams to provide the users’ perspective on our products and services.

Your daily tasks will look like this:

  • Review individual Support Case Backlog and prioritize Aged and Escalated Requests.
  • Reproduce issues in-house on test systems (Virtual Machines) to isolate the cause of the problem.
  • Monitor the Team Support Cases Queue and pick issues in the order of priority, impact, and age of the Service Request.
  • Update and follow-up with users over the phone/email on existing Requests.
  • Engage on Team Scrum calls to discuss issues and liaison with the team
  • Adhere to Phone Queue Schedule and ensure phones are always manned and voicemails processed.
  • Contribute to Bentley Communities and answer user queries.
  • Update the Team Technical Knowledge Base and share updates with the team.
  • Upskill on Product Knowledge by focusing on a new topic every week. Consume Training through internal Pathways, Wikis, videos, etc.
  • Channelize potential Defects/Enhancements to the Product Management/Development teams.
  • Provide a handover to the next shift with appropriate documentation when needed

What You Bring to The Team:

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support and exposure to global user interaction.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience or Knowledge with ProjectWise product suites or similar document management systems such as Documentum, Vault or Aconex.
  • Experience with the Administration of Engineering Information/Document Management systems.
  • Experience or knowledge with relational databases: Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
  • Experience or knowledge with Networking (DNS, TCP\IP, FQDN, cluster environments).
  • Experience or knowledge with Windows Operating System (Server and client) for administration and debugging.
  • A "user first" approach and strong critical thinking, with a desire to solve problems with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Emotional intelligence when talking with users, and the ability to document methodically.
  • Exposure to answering queries via Service Requests and Communities forum posts.
  • Ability to work well with Global colleagues to help address user issues.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by delegating, prioritizing, and scheduling tasks to ensure they are completed in the expected timelines.
  • A motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and in a team.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with ProjectWise infrastructure.
  • Knowledge or experience of IIS (Internet Information Services),
  • Proven success in all aspects of ProjectWise Administration.
  • Experience with MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, IPLOT (Printing\Plotting).
  • Knowledge with extended ProjectWise features (Publishing such as ICS for PDF, BAS; Bentley cloud features such as Deliverables Management, ProjectWise Drive, ProjectWise Projects, WSG, etc.)
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction.
  • Competitive Salary and benefits.
  • The opportunity to work within a global and diverse international team.
  • A supportive and collaborative environment.

  • A day off during your birthday week to enjoy with your family and friends, ensuring that you have a chance to make memories on your special day.

About the project:

As a C# .NET Engineer , maintain, test, and optimize a new modern software platform architecture. You must be highly skilled and experienced in a variety of modernization technologies and approaches.

You will be able to:

  • Develop and implement a scalable, flexible, and highly available modern platform architecture that aligns with our business objectives.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and documentation of the modernized software platform.
  • Build and test new ideas and designs in a “fail fast” methodology that will allow the team to assess and pivot quickly as warranted.
  • Serve in a senior role for the team, assisting junior and mid-level engineers in developing and maintaining microservices-based applications, ensuring they are modular, decoupled, and maintainable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, specifications, and integration points.
  • Utilize public cloud services, particularly Azure or AWS, to optimize platform performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Actively foster a culture of excellence and collaboration across the team.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring component reliability and uptime.
  • Stay current on industry best practices, emerging technologies, and trends related to modern platform architecture, microservices, and cloud computing.

What will help you succeed in this role:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ Years of experience in Software Development.
  • Experience working with .NET C# and .NET 6 or later.
  • Experience working with AWS or Azure.
  • Experience working with Docker or Terraform.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

• We'd love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.

Work remotely from Latin America for US clients with Nearsure, a staff augmentation company that values people and culture. Gain cross-cultural expertise and improve your English skills with daily communication in English.

Obra de aproximadamente 3 meses.

Principais desafios do seu dia a dia:

  • Implantar, acompanhar e avaliar as atividades inerentes à área de Segurança do Trabalho, visando o desenvolvimento dos programas de segurança, cumprimento de cronogramas, legislação vigente e procedimentos internos.

  • Controlar a documentação referente a saúde e segurança do trabalho de colaboradores terceirizados, garantindo que estejam em conformidade com as exigências da empresa.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CFD Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at ABS Consulting. This role is critical in advancing our computational fluid dynamics (CFD) capabilities, driving the development of cutting-edge simulations to optimize product performance and efficiency across various applications.
What You Will Do

  • Lead the development and implementation of CFD methodologies to analyze complex fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical reactions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall engineering goals.
  • Design and execute simulation plans, including grid generation, model setup, and validation against experimental data.
  • Utilize advanced post-processing techniques to analyze simulation results, identifying key insights and communicating findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CFD technology, integrating new tools and methodologies into the engineering workflow.
  • Performs advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling for quantitative risk analysis, including Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis, and Helideck Turbulence Analysis
  • Assists qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Suports Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) to ensure compliance with safety standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Implements and maintains ABS Quality System requirements relative to responsibilities after undergoing ABS Quality System training.
  • Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience:
  • Master’s in chemical, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field with a strong emphasis on fluid dynamics and experience on O&G projects.
  • Experience in CFD analysis, with proficiency in industry-standard software such as FLACS, KFX, CFX , ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or COMSOL.
  • Solid understanding of turbulence modeling, heat transfer, and multiphase flow dynamics.
  • Experience in qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis.
  • Experience in Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).
  • Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM) principles.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian regulations (e.g., Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP, NRs) is a plus.
  • Professional or chartered engineering license
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  • Good command of the English language with the ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Expertise in computational fluid dynamics simulation and modeling techniques.
  • Proficiency in software tools for mesh generation, simulation, and post-processing.
  • Understanding of numerical methods and algorithms used in CFD.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.
It Would Be Nice If You Have:
  • Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.
  • Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings.
Reporting Relationships:
The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

title: Coca-Cola Learnerships Now Open
description:
Coca-Cola Learnerships Now Open: Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa (CCBSA) is offering several learnership opportunities across the country, providing young, talented individuals with the chance to gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced beverage industry.

Whether you are interested in packaging, sales, warehouse operations, or human resources , Coca-Cola is ready to invest in your growth through National Certificates and valuable on-the-job training.

If you’re passionate, eager to learn, and ready to make an impact, read on to discover the various Coca-Cola Learnerships that you can apply for today.

Coca-Cola Learnerships Now Open – Why Apply for Coca-Cola Learnerships?

By joining the Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa learnership programs, you not only gain a recognized qualification but also valuable hands-on experience in a global organization.

You will develop important professional skills, create career pathways, and potentially secure long-term employment.

The Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa Learnerships offer:

  • Structured learning with both theoretical and practical training.
  • Access to a global brand with opportunities for career growth.
  • Mentorship and coaching to help you succeed.

Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa invites applications for the Packaging Learnership in Lakeside, Eastern Cape. This is a unique opportunity for young learners to gain industry-specific skills in beverage packaging, working within a high-tech manufacturing environment.

Key Requirements:

Grade 12 with Mathematics (not Mathematics Literacy) and Physical Science with at least 50%.

Applicants must be between 18-35 years old, and unemployed at the time of application.

A National Certificate in Food and Beverage Packaging, NQF Level 3 will be awarded on completion of the program.

If you’re ready to take on a sales role with Coca-Cola, the Sales Learnership in Daveyton, Gauteng, offers you the chance to gain knowledge in customer management, merchandising, and marketing within the beverage industry.

Key Requirements:

Grade 12 with Mathematics or Mathematics Literacy, at least 40%.

Must be between 18-35 years old, and unemployed.

Driver’s License is an advantage but not mandatory.

3. Unemployed Learner Warehouse (Countrywide)

For those with an interest in logistics and warehouse operations, Coca-Cola is offering a Warehouse Learnership across locations like Phoenix, Premier, and Elgin. This program equips learners with essential skills in freight handling, stock management, and maintaining warehouse operations.

Key Requirements:

Grade 12 with Mathematics or Mathematics Literacy passed with at least 40%.

Applicants must be between 18-35 years old, and unemployed at the time of application.

A diploma in Logistics or Operations Management is advantageous but not required.

4. Unemployed Learnership: Human Resources (Bonded for People with Disabilities)

Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa is offering a Human Resources Learnership tailored for people with disabilities in KwaZulu-Natal. This program will help you gain vital skills in business administration and HR, ultimately helping you develop a solid foundation in HR management.

Key Requirements:

Grade 12 with Mathematics or Mathematics Literacy and English with at least 40%.

Applicants must be between 18-34 years old, unemployed, and provide a valid medical record detailing the disability.

The program spans 12 months and will result in the National Certificate in Business Administration Services (NQF Level 3).

Coca-Cola Learnerships Now Open – How to Apply for Coca-Cola Learnerships:

To apply for any of the learnership programs mentioned above, you need to meet the minimum requirements listed for each opportunity. Applications can be submitted with:

  • Your updated CV.
  • A certified copy of your Matric certificate or higher qualifications.
  • For the Human Resources learnership, a medical certificate detailing your disability is required.

Visit the Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa career portal to submit your application by the closing date for each program.

Coca-Cola Learnerships Now Open – Conclusion:

Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa continues to invest in youth, providing a platform for learners to thrive and build their careers.

If you are passionate about the beverage industry and want to gain hands-on experience, don’t miss out on these exciting learnership opportunities.

Apply today and take the first step toward shaping your future with Coca-Cola.

description:
Especialista em Rentabilidade e Risco de Crédito

Join to apply for the Especialista em Rentabilidade e Risco de Crédito role at PicPay

Sobre o PicPay
Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender às necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia.
Fundada em Vitória (ES), a empresa já conta com mais de 35 milhões de clientes ativos e faz parte do grupo J&F, um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do Brasil. A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop.
Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.
O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Análise de impacto de políticas, buscando otimização de portfólio e aderência ao apetite de risco desenhados nas metas-alvo de LA (Limite de Apetite ao Risco);
  2. Projeção de rentabilidade e perdas (PDD BRGAAP & IFRS9) para produtos de crédito voltados à Pessoa Física;
  3. Desenvolvimento de calculadoras de rentabilidade para produtos de Crédito PF, com objetivo de embasar decisões estratégicas e facilitar simulações de novos cenários de negócio;
  4. Apoio a análises ad hoc para suporte às decisões de comitês e fóruns executivos;
  5. Interface constante com áreas de crédito, finanças, pricing, produtos e estratégia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  1. Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Conhecimento avançado em Excel e ferramentas de análise de dados (ex: SQL, Python, SAS ou similares);
  3. Experiência com crédito PF, análise de rentabilidade, projeção de PDD ou temas similares;
  4. Raciocínio analítico, capacidade de estruturar análises e comunicar resultados de forma clara e objetiva;
  5. Desejável conhecimento em normas contábeis BRGAAP e IFRS9.

Observação:

  • O contrato de trabalho para essa posição é presencial em nossa sede do Brooklin (R. Porto União, 295 - Brooklin - São Paulo - SP).

O que oferecemos:

Saúde e Bem-estar

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;
  • Wellhub.

Alimentação/Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho:

  • Cartão de crédito PicPay Benefícios, com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho).

Licença Paternidade e Maternidade:

  • Licença Maternidade estendida de 6 meses, e de Paternidade também estendida de 20 dias.
  • Programa "Novo Ser", que acompanha nossas mamães durante toda a gestação e no retorno da licença. Ao retornar da licença maternidade, as mamães ainda contam com a ajuda do Auxílio Creche e também os papais que possuem guarda unilateral ou compartilhada.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão.

Nosso compromisso é promover uma cultura de inclusão da diversidade, que capacita nossos colaboradores a contribuir com o seu melhor. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para as vagas, sem distinção de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade e/ou expressão de gênero, idade, raça, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

A SPDM é uma empregadora de igualdade de oportunidades de emprego para todas as pessoas que assim atendam os requisitos mínimos.

Valorizamos o compartilhamento de ideias, o desenvolvimento de uma cultura de trabalho em equipe, respeito a diversidade e inclusão.

Atuar com excelência na atenção à saúde sem preconceito, distinção ou classificação dos cidadãos.

Ser reconhecida como organização filantrópica brasileira em saúde de maior abrangência e competência.

description:
Job description

Somos um grupo e atuamos no mercado como atacadista de materiais de construção e revendedor de cosméticos e itens para casa. Nosso compromisso é oferecer excelência no atendimento, disponibilizando uma ampla diversidade de produtos para atender às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Nossa missão é proporcionar uma experiência excepcional aos nossos clientes, combinando qualidade, variedade e atendimento personalizado. Acreditamos que a satisfação do cliente é a chave para o nosso sucesso contínuo.

Estamos em busca de pessoas detalhistas e dedicadas para se juntar à nossa equipe. Procuramos indivíduos que sejam motivados e capazes de inspirar os que estão ao seu redor. Queremos colaboradores que compartilhem de nossa visão e trabalhem juntos para alcançar objetivos comuns.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e características, aqui é o seu lugar


Main responsibilities

- Liderar, treinar e motivar a equipe de vendas para atingir metas de desempenho e vendas.

- Garantir o atendimento de excelência ao cliente, criando uma experiência de compra personalizada.

- Gerenciar o estoque e assegurar a exposição adequada dos produtos na loja.

- Monitorar o desempenho das vendas e implementar estratégias para melhorar resultados.

- Gerir as operações financeiras, incluindo controle de caixa, faturamento e metas de rentabilidade.

- Desenvolver campanhas promocionais em alinhamento com a equipe de marketing e vendas.

- Realizar o recrutamento, treinamento e desenvolvimento de colaboradores.

- Assegurar o cumprimento de políticas internas e normas de segurança.

- Analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e elaborar relatórios gerenciais.


Requirements and skills

Formação em Administração, Gestão Comercial e áreas relacionadas

Conhecimento no segmento de cosméticos ou comércio varejista

Pacote office intermediário

Diferencial conhecimento em SAP

Habilidade em criar ações para alavancar as vendas

Treinar e motivar o seu time para superar suas metas
